description: Browse compact glossary summaries with absolute url links when you want an overview rather than a keyword search. Optional topic and learning-path filters intersect. Entries keep glossary order, including when filtered by path; use get_line for path order. Pages default to 25, maximum 100; total counts all filtered entries. Use get_term for full content.

categoryId.description: Topic ID from list_categories, for example "ai-and-automation" or "cloud-and-systems".

cursor.description: Copy nextCursor from the previous page and keep the same tool, filters, and detail. Omit it on the first request; restart without it after INVALID_CURSOR. The final page has no nextCursor.

limit.description: Entries per page: default 25, maximum 100. May change between pages.

lineId.description: Learning-path ID from list_lines, for example "cloud-foundations" or "ai-foundations".

name: list_terms
title: Browse glossary
